protocol: Three alternating pairs; confirm with five extra pairs if median wall time >=20% or peak RSS >=25%. Fixed seed7, 1 thread/cell. Serial pinned CPU0; parallel pinned CPU0-3. All values and checkpoints must match. C wait4 launcher measures actual child peak RSS. No concurrent own tests/builds during runs. Profiling uses clocks around cell training/evaluation and the caller save callback; profile time is attribution, not the speed comparison. Summed cell times and ready waits overlap across cells and must not be added to wall time. Tiny batch is 100 independent 45-cell tables; sum child wall times and take maximum child RSS per batch. Hashing/cleanup are outside child time.

profile_prepare_script:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
version=sys.argv[1];root=Path.cwd();out=root/'build/review-j19-profile'
for file,func,args,prefix in [('src/mus_score.c','train_score_cell','raw_worker','cell'),('app/mus_solver_cli.c','save_score_cell','game, trainer, cell, context','save')]:
 s=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'142e203:{file}'],text=True) if version=='parent' else Path(file).read_text();marker='static void *train_score_cell(' if prefix=='cell' else 'static Status save_score_cell('
 start=s.index(marker);brace=s.index('{',start);end=brace+1;depth=1
 while depth:
  depth+=(s[end]=='{')-(s[end]=='}');end+=1
 signature=s[start:brace];wrapper=signature+'{\n'
 if prefix=='cell':wrapper+='    ScoreTrainingWorker *profile_worker = raw_worker;\n    unsigned int profile_a = profile_worker->a, profile_b = profile_worker->b;\n'
 else:wrapper+='    unsigned int profile_a = game->initial_scores[0], profile_b = game->initial_scores[1];\n'
 wrapper+=f'    fprintf(stderr, "J19 {prefix}-start %u %u %.9f\\n", profile_a, profile_b, j19_time());\n'
 wrapper+='    '+('void *' if prefix=='cell' else 'Status ')+f'profile_result = {func}_measured({args});\n'
 wrapper+=f'    fprintf(stderr, "J19 {prefix}-end %u %u %.9f\\n", profile_a, profile_b, j19_time());\n    return profile_result;\n}}\n'
 s=s[:start]+s[start:end].replace(func+'(',func+'_measured(',1)+'\n'+wrapper+s[end:]
 header='#define _XOPEN_SOURCE 700\n#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L\n#include <time.h>\nstatic double j19_time(void) { struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t); return (double)t.tv_sec + (double)t.tv_nsec * 1e-9; }\n'
 path=out/f'{version}-{prefix}.c';path.write_text(header+s)
 subprocess.run(['cc','-O3','-std=c17','-Iinclude','-IC-CFR/include','-Iapp','-Isrc','-pthread','-c',str(path),'-o',str(path.with_suffix('.o'))],check=True)
lib='build/review-j18/release/libmus_solver.a' if version=='parent' else 'build/review-j19/release/libmus_solver.a'
subprocess.run(['cc',str(out/f'{version}-cell.o'),str(out/f'{version}-save.o'),'build/review-j18/release/app/score_recovery.o',lib,'C-CFR/build/review-baseline/release/libcfr.a','-lzstd','-lm','-pthread','-o',str(out/version)],check=True)
